prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Tips Banner: Add photo submission guidance text to the photo upload screen explaining optimal photo lighting and angles.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with your subject centered."}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Notice: Display a clear hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in saves pet progress safely.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to safely save your pet across app restarts and desktop sessions."}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Path Options Carousel Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a visual carousel format with choice cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "style": "playful", "text": "Select your pet journey path", "type": "choice_cards"}]}}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Photo Verification Preview Screen: Add a new confirmation screen showing a preview of uploaded photos before pet adoption processing begins.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_confirm", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"button_label": "Review Photos"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Creation Wait Progress Details: Show time estimate and notification option while waiting for the pet to load.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing your desktop companion...", "notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Tip: Add concise instructions on the home intro screen explaining desktop pet positioning and right-click menus.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick options or move them around."}}
6: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to use a stage layout with decorative badge components.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Welcome your new desktop pet!", "layout": "stage", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "style": "highlight", "text": "Official Adoption Certificate", "type": "badge"}]}}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Two Column Layout: Change the path selection screen layout to two-column to make comparing pet adoption options easier.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column"}}
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Intro Welcome Flow: Add a post-onboarding summary screen after home intro prior to final desktop placement.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_finish_summary"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Continue"}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Compact Layout: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and potential screen stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Quick Sign In", "layout": "compact"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding helpful photo upload guidance text inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a helpful persistence hint to the sign-in screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the choose_path screen into a carousel layout retains both choice paths.
Adding a new photo review confirmation screen within onboarding is allowed.
Adding time estimates and notifications to the waiting screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding helpful desktop usage tips on the home_intro screen is allowed.
Replacing the certificate element with a badge component loses the required official stamp.
Changing choose_path layout to two-column keeps both path choices intact.
Adding a new summary screen after home_intro within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Switching the sign-in screen layout to compact inside onboarding is allowed.
